description: Explore whether smaller Muon batches keep buying accuracy now that per-step overhead is graphed away. E017 showed 2000 -> 1536 gave +0.16 pp at unchanged per-image cost. On E018, switch to batch 1024: Muon lr 0.205*sqrt(1024/1536) = 0.167 and momentum 0.70, with the SGD-group lr scaled linearly with batch. Keep 9.5 epochs (48 steps/epoch, 456 steps). Recapture the CUDA graph at the new batch shape in build.
